issues.location: Across all shelves, particularly noticeable on the top and middle shelves with bottled and canned teas, and the bottom shelf with Pure Leaf bottles.

A significant portion of the bottom shelf on the far right is empty, indicating a potential stock-out or understocking for gallon-sized beverages.

issues.location: Various locations on the middle and bottom shelves.
issues.description: Some price labels are partially obscured by products or other promotional signs, potentially making it difficult for customers to read prices.

model_reasoning: The shelves are generally well-stocked, but there are several instances of product misalignment across all levels. A notable empty space is present on the bottom right shelf, indicating a potential stock issue. Additionally, some price labels are partially obscured by products or other signage, which could hinder customer experience. These issues collectively lead to a 'warning' status.
summary: Zona Z_S1 com fill rate de 88%, detetados chás (engarrafados, enlatados, em galão), bebidas de aloe, bebidas matcha e tortilhas. Problemas encontrados incluem produtos desalinhados em todas as prateleiras (especialmente nas superiores e médias com chás engarrafados/enlatados, e na inferior com garrafas Pure Leaf) com baixa severidade; uma prateleira vazia na prateleira inferior, lado direito, com severidade média; e etiquetas de preço obstruídas em várias localizações nas prateleiras média e inferior com baixa severidade. Inspeção realizada quarta-feira 19h, estado warning.
